title: sddb-warning-time-tests: power and within-patient tests of HRV-based sudden cardiac death prediction on the MIT-BIH SDDB benchmark
description: Code for the paper 'Between-database horizon tests do not establish warning times in HRV-based prediction of sudden cardiac death'. It computes HRV features from PhysioNet beat annotations (sddb, nsrdb, chfdb and the heart failure positive-control databases) and runs the horizon test, diseased controls, surrogate onsets, within-patient contrasts with permutation and drift controls, a power simulation with resampled patients, a replication of a published segment-level design, and the heart failure positive control. PhysioNet data are not included; scripts/00_get_data.py downloads the annotation files.
